facts.replacement_value: Each update compares the floating countdown with zero. A nonpositive value calls CargoWait entry; afterward it rereads the same slot and subtracts one unconditionally, including after the state change. A positive value transitions only after repeated floating-point subtraction reaches a nonpositive value. Large finite values can round back to themselves when subtracting one, so finite initial input alone does not guarantee progress. No local NaN handling exists.
